cover.coreProposition: For digital employees, a nominal action name is evidence of intent, not execution authority; when configuration, wrappers or environment can redirect behavior, admission must bind executable identity, execution context and governing policy, while approval and effect containment remain separate gates.
cover.visualMetaphor: A familiar metal key casting a much more complex mechanical shadow than its simple shape suggests
cover.semanticObject: One apparently ordinary key whose shadow reveals hidden gears and a secondary latch
cover.compositionIntent: Serious landscape editorial cover with one dominant object, restrained graphite and amber materials, and immediate thumbnail recognition
